newsitem.title: UK: Saudi tells OPEC crude output at quota in July.
newsitem.headline: Saudi tells OPEC crude output at quota in July.

text.p: Saudi Arabia told OPEC July crude oil production was at its allotted quota, the OPEC news agency reported on Wednesday.
Saudi told the OPEC secretariat in Vienna it pumped 8.0003 million barrels a day (bpd) at the wellhead and supplied markets with 8.0007 million.
The Saudi submission confirmed figures given to Reuters by industry sources earlier this week.
Venezuela told OPEC its July output was 2.413 million bpd compared to its official quota of 2.359 million.
